treatments.title: Treatments & Technologies
treatments.description: Advanced protocols performed with cutting-edge technology and up-to-date techniques for precise and safe results.
treatments.treatment1Desc: Science applied to cellular regeneration. Acts on mitochondrial metabolism to reduce chronic pain, accelerate healing, treat post-surgical fibrosis, lipedema and post-operative recovery. Exclusive evidence-based protocols.
treatments.treatment2Desc: Considered the world's best laser — over 80 treatment protocols. Includes Fotona 6D (deep facial rejuvenation), Smooth Eyes, IntimaLase and IncontiLase. Minimally invasive, with visible results immediately after the session.
treatments.treatment3Desc: The IncontiLase protocol with Fotona Laser strengthens intimate tissue, improving urinary control non-surgically. Quick procedure with no downtime. Includes improved lubrication, vaginal elasticity and external rejuvenation.
treatments.treatment4Desc: Modern, non-surgical and highly strategic protocol targeting the root of the problem: inflammation. Combines anti-inflammatory dietary re-education, guided physical activity and photobiomodulation to reduce pain, swelling and improve quality of life.
treatments.treatment5Desc: IntimaLase improves intimate lubrication, vaginal elasticity, prevents recurrent infections and promotes internal and external rejuvenation in a single session — with deep collagen stimulation without surgery.
treatments.treatment6Desc: Customized protocols to soften wrinkles, improve firmness and restore a younger, healthier appearance. Techniques that stimulate collagen and improve skin texture, respecting each patient's individual characteristics.
treatments.treatment7Desc: Treatments with Endotight (minimally invasive) and Tight Sculpting (non-invasive), combined or not with biostimulators and mesotherapy. Stimulate collagen and elastin production for progressive and impactful results in skin firmness.
treatments.treatment8Desc: Personalized improvement of gluteal contour, volume and symmetry with minimally invasive techniques and advanced technologies. Natural results that enhance the silhouette safely and proportionally.
treatments.treatment9Desc: Quick and safe procedure to smooth expression lines and prevent premature aging. Natural results that provide a lighter, more rested appearance without compromising facial expressiveness.
treatments.treatment10Desc: Stimulate natural collagen production, improving firmness, elasticity and skin quality over time. Progressive results lasting up to one and a half years — an excellent option for natural and long-lasting rejuvenation.
treatments.note: Each procedure recommendation is made after thorough medical evaluation, always with shared decision-making and clear guidance to the patient.

faq.title: What Our Patients Say
faq.description: Real stories from those who trusted their care to Dra. Júlia Saggiomo.
faq.testimonial1Text: I am so grateful to have met Dra. Julia and had my surgery with her. From the very beginning, I felt safe and welcomed. The result was sensational and exceeded my expectations. More than an aesthetic change, it was the starting point for a turning point in my life — the beginning of a phase where I started taking better care of myself, my health, diet and well-being. Today I feel more confident and happy. I can only be grateful and recommend her without hesitation.
faq.testimonial2Text: From the very first moment, I felt safe and welcomed. The way she explains every detail, with clarity and calm, makes all the difference — you understand the process and trust it. I had an abdominoplasty, liposuction, blepharoplasty and hyaluronic acid fillers, and I am extremely satisfied with the results. Everything looked very natural, respecting my features, exactly as I wanted. Today I feel more confident, happier with my image, and I am deeply grateful for all the work done. I would recommend Dr. Júlia without any hesitation.
faq.testimonial3Text: Today I realize how much this treatment has done me good. Every day I feel better. I hadn't felt happiness for a long time, and now I do. I want to thank you so much for giving me back the will for everything, because my life had become so dull — and you gave me a new perspective. My gratitude is enormous. I am so happy, truly so happy. It was a long time feeling those pains, suffering with them, and now I can move more and more. Thank you so much!

resultados.galleryDesc: Real transformations performed with technique, safety and personalized care.
resultados.ctaDesc: Schedule your appointment and discover the ideal procedure for you — with safety, naturalness and personalized care.
resultados.proc_blefaroplastia_desc: Removes excess skin, fat pockets and muscle around the eyes — younger, more rested and natural-looking gaze. Can be complemented with Laser, Skinboosters or fat transfer for even more impactful results. Painless post-operative and quick recovery.
resultados.proc_lipoaspiracao_desc: Removes localized fat and reshapes other areas with extracted fat — available from Soft Definition to High Definition (HD). Can be combined with Abdominoplasty for even greater body contour refinement.
resultados.proc_abdominoplastia_desc: Removes excess skin and fat from the abdomen and corrects muscle sagging and diastasis — indicated after significant weight loss or pregnancy. When combined with Liposuction or Liposculpture, contour and definition results are even more expressive.
resultados.proc_mamoplastia_desc: Mammoplasty increases or reduces breast volume, improving proportion and self-esteem. Mastopexy repositions and restores firmness to the breasts, and can be combined with implants. Scars positioned in the natural skin folds with increasingly discreet techniques.
resultados.proc_lifting_facial_desc: Advanced technique that acts on the deeper layers of the face, repositioning muscles and tissues for a natural and long-lasting result. It treats the cause of facial aging — not just its signs. Superficial procedures do not achieve the same structural effects.
resultados.proc_laser_desc: Treatments with Fotona Laser — the safest and most versatile in the world. Protocols include Fotona 6D (deep facial rejuvenation), Smooth Eyes, IntimaLase, IncontiLase, Tight Sculpting and body sagging treatment. Visible results with minimal recovery.
resultados.proc_lipo_papada_desc: Facial contour definition with elimination of submental fat.
resultados.proc_fotobiomodulacao_desc: Science applied to cellular regeneration — acts on mitochondrial metabolism modulating inflammation and pain. Indicated for chronic and acute pain, wound healing, post-liposuction fibrosis, biostimulator nodules, lipedema and post-operative recovery.
resultados.proc_cirurgias_combinadas_desc: Multiple procedures in a single surgical act with integrated planning.
resultados.proc_lipedema_desc: Non-surgical and strategic protocol targeting inflammation as the root of the problem. Combination of anti-inflammatory dietary re-education, guided physical activity and photobiomodulation to reduce pain, swelling, fluid retention and improve quality of life.
